work: Encyclopedia of Korean Folk Culture: articles on lineage, succession, adoption,
heading: 파종가 派宗家 · 파종가 · 특징 및 의의 … 참고문헌

items.text: Perform the ancestral rites for the ancestor with devotion.
items.citation: Encyclopedia of Korean Folk Culture, 파종가 특징 및 의의
items.quote: 조상에 대한 봉제사 — ancestral rites for ancestors

items.text: Receive visitors with hospitality, providing for them as the house is able.
items.citation: Encyclopedia of Korean Folk Culture, 파종가 특징 및 의의
items.quote: 방문객에 대한 접빈객 — hospitality for visitors

items.text: Inherit and continue the founding ancestor's life and traces.
items.citation: Encyclopedia of Korean Folk Culture, 파종가 특징 및 의의
items.quote: 그 조상의 삶과 자취를 계승하려는 종가가 파종가이다 — the jongga that seeks to inherit that ancestor's life and traces

work: Encyclopedia of Korean Folk Culture: articles on lineage, succession, adoption,
heading: 문중 門中 … 역사

items.text: Offer the ancestral rites for the whole lineage, as the heir of the main line.
items.citation: Encyclopedia of Korean Folk Culture, 문중 門中 역사
items.quote: 장남봉사가 보편화되었다 — eldest-son ancestral rites became universal.
items.conflict: Conflicts with the first commandment: worship God alone.

items.text: Keep affection and unity with all your kinsmen.
items.citation: Encyclopedia of Korean Folk Culture, 문중 門中 역사
items.quote: 자손들 상호 간의 친화와 단결 — friendship and unity among descendants.

work: Encyclopedia of Korean Folk Culture: articles on lineage, succession, adoption,
heading: 종회 宗會 · 종회 · 특징 및 의의 … 참고문헌

items.text: Hold ancestral rites for the founding ancestor of the region and for those whose spirit tablets are kept unremoved.
items.citation: Encyclopedia of Korean Folk Culture, 종회 宗會 · 종회 · 특징 및 의의 … 참고문헌
items.quote: 지역의 입향조를 비롯한 불천위 조상제사를 지내고 — hold ancestral rites for the founding ancestor of the region and the unremovable spirit tablets

items.text: Manage the clan's common property faithfully for the benefit of the whole descent group.
items.citation: Encyclopedia of Korean Folk Culture, 종회 宗會 · 종회 · 특징 및 의의 … 참고문헌
items.quote: 공동 재산을 관리하며 — manage common property

items.text: Join the clan gatherings to strengthen the solidarity of the patrilineal kin group.
items.citation: Encyclopedia of Korean Folk Culture, 종회 宗會 · 종회 · 특징 및 의의 … 참고문헌
items.quote: 부계혈연집단의 결속을 도모하는 것이었다 — promote the solidarity of the patrilineal kin group

items.text: Hand down the descent group's communal Confucian traditions to the rising generation.
items.citation: Encyclopedia of Korean Folk Culture, 종회 宗會 · 종회 · 특징 및 의의 … 참고문헌
items.quote: 부계혈연집단의 공동체적 유교문화를 전승하던 지역 모임이다 — a regional meeting that transmitted the communal Confucian culture of the patrilineal kin group

work: Encyclopedia of Korean Folk Culture: articles on lineage, succession, adoption,
heading: 촌수 寸數 · 촌수 · 특징 및 의의 … 참고문헌

items.text: Learn the degrees of kinship and keep mutual relations in the order of the clan law.
items.citation: Encyclopedia of Korean Folk Culture, 촌수 寸數 · 촌수 · 특징 및 의의
items.quote: 촌수는 부모의 혼인으로 이루어지는 친족과 외척의 혈연적 친소관계를 수치로 표현한 것이다.

items.text: Within the same great-great-grandfather's line, join together in the ancestral rites.
items.citation: Encyclopedia of Korean Folk Culture, 촌수 寸數 · 촌수 · 특징 및 의의
items.quote: ‘동고조팔촌’이라는 친족 범위는 제사 및 상속과 관련하여 친족집단 내에 이해를 같이하는 최소 단위로 설정된 것이다.
items.conflict: Ancestor veneration conflicts with worship of God alone (Exodus 20:3-5).

work: Encyclopedia of Korean Folk Culture: articles on lineage, succession, adoption,
heading: 종손 宗孫 … 내용

items.text: Act as the clan's representative: attend other clans' rites and exercise the clan's vote in decisions between clans.
items.citation: Encyclopedia of Korean Folk Culture, 종손 宗孫
items.quote: 문중 간 의사결정 시 문중을 대표하여 의결권을 행사한다 — In decisions between clans, he exercises the clan's vote.

items.text: Offer the first libation at the rite of the undying ancestors.
items.citation: Encyclopedia of Korean Folk Culture, 종손 宗孫
items.quote: 불천위제사에서는 종손이 초헌 — In the rite for the undying ancestors, the lineage heir offers the first libation.
items.conflict: Bible forbids worship of the dead; all worship belongs to God alone.

items.text: Offer the second libation at the rite of the undying ancestors.
items.citation: Encyclopedia of Korean Folk Culture, 종손 宗孫
items.quote: 종부가 아헌 — The wife of the lineage heir offers the second libation.
items.conflict: Bible forbids worship of the dead; all worship belongs to God alone.
items.needs_role: wife of the lineage heir (宗婦)

items.text: Perform your role faithfully; do not bring shame on the clan, or you may be expelled and the line of succession changed.
items.citation: Encyclopedia of Korean Folk Culture, 종손 宗孫
items.quote: 만약 종손이 그 역할을 충실히 수행하지 못하거나 종족의 명예를 실추하는 경우 축출될 수 있으며 — If the lineage heir fails to perform his role or dishonors the clan, he may be expelled.

items.text: Return to the head house and settle there; it is the place you are bound to return to.
items.citation: Encyclopedia of Korean Folk Culture, 종손 宗孫
items.quote: 종가는 종손이 언젠가는 돌아가야만 하는 예정된 공간이었다 — The head house was a predestined space to which the lineage heir must someday return.

items.text: Pool funds to support the lineage heir's education, that he may raise the clan.
items.citation: Encyclopedia of Korean Folk Culture, 종손 宗孫
items.quote: 십시일반으로 돈을 내어 종손이 대학에 다닐 수 있도록 지원해 — pooled money to support the lineage heir through university

items.text: Accept the heavy responsibility of the clan's support and devote yourself wholly to the head house's affairs.
items.citation: Encyclopedia of Korean Folk Culture, 종손 宗孫
items.quote: 종손으로서 감당해야 할 운명적 위치를 자각해서 종가 일에 전념하도록 — to make him recognize his fateful position and devote himself to head-house work

work: Encyclopedia of Korean Folk Culture: articles on lineage, succession, adoption,
heading: 종손 宗孫 · 종손 · 특징 및 의의 … 참고문헌

items.text: Treat the lineage heir with special care and deference wherever he goes.
items.citation: Encyclopedia of Korean Folk Culture, 종손 宗孫
items.quote: 누구에게나 특별한 존재로 인식되고, 언제 어디서나 남들로부터 ‘위함’을 받으며 성장한다 — recognized as special by everyone and grows receiving deference from others wherever he goes.

items.text: Teach the eldest grandson the duties and rites of the lineage heir from childhood.
items.citation: Encyclopedia of Korean Folk Culture, 종손 宗孫
items.quote: 어린 시절부터 조부로부터 받은 종손 교육 — from childhood received training as lineage heir from his grandfather.

items.text: Upon the death of the head, perform the auspicious rite to succeed as master of the house.
items.citation: Encyclopedia of Korean Folk Culture, 종손 宗孫
items.quote: 종손 사후 차종손은 길제吉祭를 통해 새로운 종가의 주인으로 승계된다 — after the death of the head, the next heir succeeds as master of the house through the auspicious rite.
items.conflict: Ancestral rites violate the Second Commandment; honor the dead with burial and remembrance, not offerings.

items.text: Carry out the family's ancestral rites as one called to preserve the Confucian tradition.
items.citation: Encyclopedia of Korean Folk Culture, 종손 宗孫
items.quote: 유교문화와 제례 전통을 실현하는 존재로서의 소명을 받아들이며 살고 있다 — accept the calling to realize Confucian culture and ancestral rites.
items.conflict: Ancestral rites violate the Second Commandment; worship belongs to God alone.

items.text: Take as your wife a woman who has never been married, as the clan custom requires.
items.citation: Encyclopedia of Korean Folk Culture, 종손 宗孫
items.quote: 종가의 종부는 반드시 결혼하지 않은 여성을 혼입하는 것을 종법적 관례로 하고 있으므로 — it is a clan-law custom that the wife of the head must be a woman who has never married.
items.conflict: No biblical requirement that a wife be a virgin; widows may remarry.

work: Encyclopedia of Korean Folk Culture: articles on lineage, succession, adoption,
heading: 족보 族譜 · 족보 · 내용

items.text: Perform the ancestral rites for the four generations up to the great-great-grandfather, and do not neglect them.
items.citation: Encyclopedia of Korean Folk Culture: 족보 族譜 · 족보 · 내용
items.quote: 고조까지의 4대 봉사만 허용 — Only ancestral rites for the four generations up to the great-great-grandfather were allowed.
items.conflict: Exodus 20:3-5; Deuteronomy 18:10-12

items.text: Observe the death anniversaries of ancestors and join in the grave rites at the family burial ground.
items.citation: Encyclopedia of Korean Folk Culture: 족보 族譜 · 족보 · 내용
items.quote: 사망 월일과 묘지 위치 정보는 제삿날인 기일을 공시하고 선영에서의 묘제를 함께하기 위한 기록이다 — The dates of death and grave locations were recorded to announce the death anniversaries and to hold grave rites together at the ancestral burial ground.
items.conflict: Deuteronomy 18:10-12; Isaiah 8:19

work: Encyclopedia of Korean Folk Culture: articles on lineage, succession, adoption,
heading: 종가 宗家 · 종가 · 내용 … 참고문헌

items.text: Continue the lineage and reverently perform the ancestral rites handed down for generations.
items.citation: Encyclopedia of Korean Folk Culture, 종가 宗家 · 종가 · 내용
items.quote: 조상 대대로 내려온 가계를 계승하고 조상의 제사를 받들어 모시는 것이다 — Continue the family line and respectfully serve the ancestral rites.

items.text: Take interest in, care for, and generously provide for the households of many branch descendants.
items.citation: Encyclopedia of Korean Folk Culture, 종가 宗家 · 종가 · 내용
items.quote: 많은 지손의 가정에 관심을 가지고 보살피며 베풀어야 할 책무도 있었다 — They also had the duty to take interest in, care for, and give to many branch descendants' households.

items.text: Welcome and generously serve the many guests who visit the head family.
items.citation: Encyclopedia of Korean Folk Culture, 종가 宗家 · 종가 · 내용
items.quote: 종가를 방문하는 수많은 지손들과 손님들을 정성껏 접대하는 것 또한 종가의 실천과 의무인 것이다 — Devoutly serving the many branch descendants and guests who visit the head family is also a practice and duty.

items.text: Lead the clan and community in noblesse oblige: serve the nation in crisis and open the granary to feed the hungry in spring.
items.citation: Encyclopedia of Korean Folk Culture, 종가 宗家 · 종가 · 내용
items.quote: 국가가 위기에 처하면 먼저 나아가 몸과 마음을 바쳐 충성을 다하고, 춘궁기에는 곳간을 열어 어려운 이웃을 도와주는 등 — When the nation is in crisis, step forward with body and mind in loyalty; in spring poverty, open the granary to help struggling neighbors.

items.text: Put into practice the family's customs and the ancestors' last instructions.
items.citation: Encyclopedia of Korean Folk Culture, 종가 宗家 · 종가 · 내용
items.quote: 종가의 가풍과 조상의 유훈을 실천에 옮겨야 하는 도덕적 의무를 진다 — They bear the moral duty to put into practice the head family's customs and the ancestors' last words.

items.text: Prepare food and serve guests with utmost care as the head family's daughter-in-law.
items.citation: Encyclopedia of Korean Folk Culture, 종가 宗家 · 종가 · 내용
items.quote: 손님을 접대하기 위해 음식을 마련하는 종부의 역할이 두드러지기도 한다 — The role of the jongbu in preparing food to entertain guests is especially prominent.

items.text: Manage the head family's property to sustain the lineage and scholarly tradition.
items.citation: Encyclopedia of Korean Folk Culture, 종가 宗家 · 종가 · 내용
items.quote: 이를 뒷받침하기 위한 종가 재산의 관리 등이 바로 그러한 노력이었다 — Managing the head family's property to support this was precisely such an effort.

items.text: When you meet orphans, the old and childless, widowers, widows, and the destitute, pity and help them; prepare for famine by planting oaks.
items.citation: Encyclopedia of Korean Folk Culture, 종가 宗家 · 종가 · 내용
items.quote: 어려서 부모를 잃은 아이[孤], 늙어서 자녀가 없는 사람[擉]과 늙어서 아내가 없는 사람[鰥], 늙어서 남편이 없는 사람[寡]과 의지할 곳이 없는 사람 등이 있으면 불쌍히 여기고 자신의 근심처럼 생각하고 도와주었다 — When she encountered orphans, the old and childless, widowers, widows, and the helpless, she pitied them, treated their worries as her own, and helped them.

items.text: Preserve the head family's material and spiritual heritage—the old house, heirloom foods, family education, rites, and old documents—in cooperation with clan members.
items.citation: Encyclopedia of Korean Folk Culture, 종가 宗家 · 종가 · 내용
items.quote: 종가는 종택, 내림 음식, 가정교육, 의례, 고문서, 고문헌 같은 수많은 물질적・정신적 유산을 보존하고 있다 — The head family preserves many material and spiritual heritages such as the old house, heirloom foods, family education, rites, and old documents.

work: Encyclopedia of Korean Folk Culture: articles on lineage, succession, adoption,
heading: 당내 堂內 … 참고문헌

items.text: Wear the prescribed three-month mourning garment when a great-great-grandparent dies.
items.citation: Encyclopedia of Korean Folk Culture, 당내 堂內
items.quote: 고조부모의 상에는 재최 3월 — For mourning great-great-grandparents, wear three-month hemp cloth.

items.text: Wear the prescribed mourning garment for kinsmen of the same generation within eight degrees when they die.
items.citation: Encyclopedia of Korean Folk Culture, 당내 堂內
items.quote: 족형제와 족자매, 즉 8촌 형제와 자매의 상에는 시마를 적용하였다 — For mourning 8th-degree siblings, apply hemp cloth.

work: Encyclopedia of Korean Folk Culture: articles on lineage, succession, adoption,
heading: 상속 相續 · 상속 · 특징 및 의의 … 참고문헌

work: Encyclopedia of Korean Folk Culture: articles on lineage, succession, adoption,
heading: 친족 親族 · 친족 · 특징 및 의의 … 참고문헌

items.text: Perform the ancestral rites for the ancestors from whom you inherit them.
items.citation: Encyclopedia of Korean Folk Culture, 친족 親族 · 친족 · 특징 및 의의 … 참고문헌
items.quote: 부모와 자식, 선조와 후손 간에 제사상속 — Between parents and children, ancestors and descendants, inheritance of ancestral rites
items.conflict: Ancestor veneration; worship belongs to God alone (Exod 20:3-5)

work: Encyclopedia of Korean Folk Culture: articles on lineage, succession, adoption,
heading: 종계 宗契 … 참고문헌

items.text: Guard the graves of ancestors and perform the grave rites for them without fail.
items.citation: Encyclopedia of Korean Folk Culture, 종계
items.quote: 조상의 분묘 수호와 묘제 봉행 및 후손 간의 친목을 도모하기 위해 만들어진 조직. — an organization made to guard ancestors' graves, perform grave rites, and promote friendship among descendants.
items.conflict: Offering rites to the dead conflicts with worshiping God alone (Deut. 26:14; 1 Cor. 10:20).

items.text: Help one another in need and encourage one another to do good, as the association rules require.
items.citation: Encyclopedia of Korean Folk Culture, 종계
items.quote: 종계 규약은 주로 제사 및 위토位土의 관리, 종계 구성원 간의 권선징악이나 상부상조, 절제와 검약, 인화 등을 강조했다. — The rules emphasized managing rites and land, encouraging good and punishing evil, mutual aid, frugality, and harmony.

items.text: As the line heir, represent the clan and oversee the ancestral property and rites.
items.citation: Encyclopedia of Korean Folk Culture, 종계
items.quote: 보통 종손이나 문중의 연장자이자 항렬이 높은 문장門長이 종계를 대표한다. — Usually the line heir or an elder of high generation represents the association.

items.text: Provide funds for the grave rites from your own means, as the line heir.
items.citation: Encyclopedia of Korean Folk Culture, 종계
items.quote: 조상의 묘제墓祭를 지낼 비용의 염출은 종손의 기부나 공동 갹출을 통해 마련한다. — The cost of the grave rites is met by the line heir's donation or common contribution.
items.conflict: Ancestral offerings conflict with the command not to give offerings to the dead (Ps. 106:28).

items.text: Contribute to the common fund for the ancestral rites.
items.citation: Encyclopedia of Korean Folk Culture, 종계
items.quote: 공동 갹출을 통해 마련한다. — met by common contribution.
items.conflict: Ancestral offerings conflict with the command not to give offerings to the dead (Ps. 106:28).

items.text: Live in harmony with your kinsmen, as the association rules require.
items.citation: Encyclopedia of Korean Folk Culture, 종계
items.quote: 인화 등을 강조했다. — emphasized harmony and such.

items.text: As a steward (유사), manage the clan property, supervise the grave keepers, and prepare the rites.
items.citation: Encyclopedia of Korean Folk Culture, 종계
items.quote: 유사有司라고 하는데, 문중 재산과 선산을 관리하며 산직山直이나 묘직墓直을 감독하고 묘제를 준비하는 일을 맡는다. — called yusa, manages clan property and ancestral mountain, supervises grave keepers, and prepares rites.

work: Encyclopedia of Korean Folk Culture: articles on lineage, succession, adoption,
heading: 가장 家長 · 가장 · 특징 및 의의 … 참고문헌

items.text: Obey the household head, who has the right to command the family members.
items.citation: Encyclopedia of Korean Folk Culture, 가장 家長 · 가장 · 특징 및 의의 … 참고문헌
items.quote: 가장권은 가족구성원을 통솔하는 권한으로 — The household head's authority is the right to command the family members.

items.text: Submit to your husband's authority as the household head, as the subordinate conjugal relationship of traditional society required.
items.citation: Encyclopedia of Korean Folk Culture, 가장 家長 · 가장 · 특징 및 의의 … 참고문헌
items.quote: 전통사회의 종속적 부부관계 — the subordinate conjugal relationship of traditional society.

work: Encyclopedia of Korean Folk Culture: articles on lineage, succession, adoption,
heading: 종가 宗家 … 역사

items.text: As the eldest legitimate son, succeed to the headship of the lineage and continue the legitimate paternal line.
items.citation: 한국민속대백과사전, 종가 宗家 … 역사
items.quote: 적장자嫡長子를 중심으로 한 부계혈통의 정통성이 계승되어 온 집 — a household where the legitimate paternal line has been handed down through the eldest legitimate son.

items.text: Hold the ancestral rite for the honored founding or branch ancestor from generation to generation without fail, and do not remove his spirit tablet from the shrine.
items.citation: 한국민속대백과사전, 종가 宗家 … 역사
items.quote: 신주를 사당에서 옮기지 않고 자손 대대로 제사를 지내도록 — Do not move the spirit tablet from the shrine, and have descendants perform ancestral rites for generations.
items.conflict: Conflicts with the Second Commandment; the dead cannot receive worship.

work: Encyclopedia of Korean Folk Culture: articles on lineage, succession, adoption,
heading: 문중 門中 · 문중 · 특징 및 의의 … 참고문헌

items.text: Honor the ancestors: perform the ancestral rites and hold their memory in reverence.
items.citation: Encyclopedia of Korean Folk Culture, 문중 · 특징 및 의의
items.quote: 조상을 숭배하고 제사를 중시하는 의식이 매우 강하다 — The worship of ancestors and the emphasis on ancestral rites is very strong.
items.conflict: Worship is due to God alone; rites to ancestors are idolatry.

items.text: As the eldest son and heir of the main line, serve the ancestral rites and keep them from generation to generation.
items.citation: Encyclopedia of Korean Folk Culture, 문중 · 특징 및 의의
items.quote: 장남봉사 — the eldest son serves the ancestral rites.
items.conflict: Ancestor worship is idolatry; the living do not serve the dead with offerings.

items.text: Guard the lineage's purity: admit no outsider to its rites or governance; keep the blood line undefiled.
items.citation: Encyclopedia of Korean Folk Culture, 문중 · 특징 및 의의
items.quote: 비혈연자의 참여를 엄격히 통제하여 혈연의 순수성을 특히 강조하며 — Strictly control the participation of non-kin and especially emphasize the purity of blood.
items.conflict: In Christ there is neither Jew nor Greek; exclusion by blood is contrary to the gospel.

items.text: Give the eldest son a larger share of the inheritance so he can discharge the ancestral rites.
items.citation: Encyclopedia of Korean Folk Culture, 문중 · 특징 및 의의
items.quote: 장남우대상속 — preferential inheritance for the eldest son.
items.conflict: Providing for idolatrous rites is complicity; inheritance should be governed by love and justice, not ritual need.

items.text: Uphold the social standing and cultural legacy your ancestors left to the family.
items.citation: Encyclopedia of Korean Folk Culture, 문중 · 특징 및 의의
items.quote: 조상의 사회적 지위와 조상이 남긴 문화적 유산을 계승하고자 노력함으로써 — Striving to inherit the social status of the ancestors and the cultural heritage they left.

work: Encyclopedia of Korean Folk Culture: articles on lineage, succession, adoption,
heading: 문중 門中 · 문중 · 내용

items.text: Keep the ancestral sacrifice for four generations from the house property.
items.citation: Encyclopedia of Korean Folk Culture, 문중 門中 · 문중 · 내용
items.quote: 4대(고조부모)까지의 조상에 대해서는 봉사손(종손)의 가산으로 기제사를 모시게 된다 — For ancestors up to four generations, the heir's household holds the sacrificial rite.
items.conflict: Conflicts with biblical teaching against communing with the dead (Deut 18:10-12; Luke 16:19-31).

items.text: After the fifth generation, cease the house sacrifice and carry out the tomb rite.
items.citation: Encyclopedia of Korean Folk Culture, 문중 門中 · 문중 · 내용
items.quote: 제사의 대상이 되는 조상이 5대를 넘으면 기제사를 중단하고 묘제로 옮기게 된다 — When an ancestor exceeds the fifth generation, the house rite stops and shifts to the tomb rite.
items.conflict: Conflicts with biblical teaching against communing with the dead (Deut 18:10-12; Luke 16:19-31).

items.text: For ancestors beyond the fifth generation, set apart land for their sacrifices and tomb care.
items.citation: Encyclopedia of Korean Folk Culture, 문중 門中 · 문중 · 내용
items.quote: 5대 이상의 조상제사와 묘소 관리를 위해 별도의 위토를 마련하지 않으면 안 된다 — For ancestors beyond the fifth generation, land must be set aside for their rites and tomb upkeep.
items.conflict: Conflicts with biblical teaching against communing with the dead (Deut 18:10-12; Luke 16:19-31).

items.text: Preside over the rites, guard the head house and family shrine, and keep the relics of the ancestors.
items.citation: Encyclopedia of Korean Folk Culture, 문중 門中 · 문중 · 내용
items.quote: 종손은... 제사를 주재하고, 종가와 가묘를 지키며, 조상의 유품을 보존・관리하는 중요한 임무를 수행 — The heir presides over the rites, guards the house and shrine, and preserves the ancestors' relics.
items.conflict: Conflicts with biblical teaching against communing with the dead (Deut 18:10-12; Luke 16:19-31).

items.text: Give the heir of the main line special honor and respect.
items.citation: Encyclopedia of Korean Folk Culture, 문중 門中 · 문중 · 내용
items.quote: 종족 성원으로부터 특별히 우대되고 존숭尊崇된다 — He is specially favored and honored by the lineage members.

items.text: Assist the lineage heir, gather the clan's will, and establish the order of the lineage law.
items.citation: Encyclopedia of Korean Folk Culture, 문중 門中 · 문중 · 내용
items.quote: 문장은 종손을 보좌하여 문중의 의사를 결집하고 종법 질서를 확립하는 중심인물 — The clan leader assists the heir, gathers the clan's will, and establishes lineage order.

items.text: Carry out the practical affairs assigned under the direction of the lineage heir and the clan leader.
items.citation: Encyclopedia of Korean Folk Culture, 문중 門中 · 문중 · 내용
items.quote: 여러 명의 유사有司가 종손과 문장의 지휘를 받아 각기 소관 업무를 나누어 맡는다 — Several officers receive direction from the heir and clan leader and divide the assigned duties.

items.text: Bring major decisions—settlement of accounts, election of officers, and main projects—for decision at the clan assembly.
items.citation: Encyclopedia of Korean Folk Culture, 문중 門中 · 문중 · 내용
items.quote: 주요 사업의 결정과 결산보고 및 유사의 선출 등 중요한 사항은 문중 총회에서 의결한다 — Major decisions, account reports, and election of officers are decided in the clan assembly.

items.text: Promote the welfare of fellow clan members and give mutual help.
items.citation: Encyclopedia of Korean Folk Culture, 문중 門中 · 문중 · 내용
items.quote: 문중 성원들의 복리증진과 상호부조 — promoting the welfare of members and mutual aid.

items.text: Hold fast to the consciousness of common descent and unite strongly as one lineage.
items.citation: Encyclopedia of Korean Folk Culture, 문중 門中 · 문중 · 내용
items.quote: 문중 성원들이 ‘우리’라는 공동체의식 즉 종족의식을 가지고 강하게 결합하여야 — members must strongly unite with the consciousness of one lineage.

work: Encyclopedia of Korean Folk Culture: articles on lineage, succession, adoption,
heading: 종부 宗婦 … 내용

items.text: Serve the ancestor rites and receive the guests.
items.citation: Encyclopedia of Korean Folk Culture, 종부 宗婦 내용
items.quote: 제사를 받들고 빈객을 접대하는 일 — serve the ancestral rites and receive guests.

items.text: If the eldest son and his wife die childless, take up the ancestor rites in her stead.
items.citation: Encyclopedia of Korean Folk Culture, 종부 宗婦 내용
items.quote: 장자가 아들이 없이 아내와 함께 죽었을 경우에는 차자의 아내가 ... 선조의 제사를 받드는 것입니다. — If the eldest son and wife die childless, the second son's wife takes up the ancestor rites.

items.text: Obey the eldest daughter-in-law, for she has sole command over the other daughters-in-law.
items.citation: Encyclopedia of Korean Folk Culture, 종부 宗婦 내용
items.quote: 총부는 여타의 며느리들에 대해 독점적 지휘권을 가진다 — the chief wife has sole command over the other daughters-in-law.
items.needs_role: younger daughters-in-law to the eldest daughter-in-law (宗婦)

items.text: Mourn your father-in-law for three years before the succession rite.
items.citation: Encyclopedia of Korean Folk Culture, 종부 宗婦 내용
items.quote: 시부가 돌아가시면 3년 정도 애도의 기간을 거친 후 비로소 시행된다 — When the father-in-law dies, after a mourning period of about three years it is then carried out.

items.text: Practice womanly virtue and internalize Confucian morality as a wife in his family.
items.citation: Encyclopedia of Korean Folk Culture, 종부 宗婦 내용
items.quote: 남편의 친족공동체 삶 한가운데로 혼입한 종부는 전통적 여성의 덕목인 부덕을 실천함으로써 유교적 도덕성을 내면화한다 — Joining her husband's kin community, the jongbu practices womanly virtue and internalizes Confucian morality.

work: Encyclopedia of Korean Folk Culture: articles on lineage, succession, adoption,
heading: 종회 宗會 · 종회 · 내용

items.text: Honor the ancestors, beginning with the founding ancestor; keep their graves and perform the memorial rites.
items.citation: Encyclopedia of Korean Folk Culture, 종회 宗會 · 종회 · 내용
items.quote: 종회에서는 지역의 입향조를 비롯하여 뛰어난 조상을 기리며, 묘소를 관리하고, 묘제를 지내고 — In the jonghoe they honor the ancestors, beginning with the regional founder, manage the graves, and perform the grave rites.
items.conflict: Worship God alone; do not offer religious rites to the dead (Deut 18:11).

items.text: Manage the common property of the lineage, such as the ritual hall and its land, for the good of all members.
items.citation: Encyclopedia of Korean Folk Culture, 종회 宗會 · 종회 · 내용
items.quote: 재실齋室·위토 등의 공유 재산을 관리하며 — manage the common property such as the ritual hall and its land.

items.text: Keep close fellowship with fellow clan members and promote their unity.
items.citation: Encyclopedia of Korean Folk Culture, 종회 宗會 · 종회 · 내용
items.quote: 구성원들의 결속을 도모한다 — promote solidarity among its members.

items.text: Compile the genealogy and keep the lineage record faithfully.
items.citation: Encyclopedia of Korean Folk Culture, 종회 宗會 · 종회 · 내용
items.quote: 족보 편찬을 위한 수단사업修單事業을 하고 — carry out projects for compiling the genealogy.

items.text: Establish and maintain schools to teach the young of the clan.
items.citation: Encyclopedia of Korean Folk Culture, 종회 宗會 · 종회 · 내용
items.quote: 서당을 지어 운영하고 — establish and operate village schools.

work: Encyclopedia of Korean Folk Culture: articles on lineage, succession, adoption,
heading: 파종가 派宗家 … 내용

items.text: Offer the four-generation rite to the branch founder in perpetuity; do not move his tablet.
items.citation: Encyclopedia of Korean Folk Culture, 파종가
items.quote: 불천위 조상으로 추대 — elevated as an ancestor not to be moved
items.conflict: Conflicts with the first commandment (Ex 20:3)

items.text: Succeed to the headship of the branch lineage as the legitimate eldest son and carry its succession in your house.
items.citation: Encyclopedia of Korean Folk Culture, 파종가
items.quote: 적장자를 중심으로 한 부계혈통의 정통성이 계승되어 온 집 — a house where the legitimacy of the paternal line centered on the legitimate eldest son has been succeeded

items.text: If an ancestor's learning, virtue, or office stands out, after public consensus elevate him to imperishable status and establish his branch.
items.citation: Encyclopedia of Korean Folk Culture, 파종가
items.quote: 그의 학문, 덕행, 관직 등이 우뚝하다 하여 ... 지역사회의 공론을 거쳐 불천위 조상으로 추대 — because his learning, virtue, office, etc. were outstanding ... after public consensus, elevate him as an ancestor not to be moved
items.conflict: Conflicts with the first commandment (Ex 20:3)

items.text: Regard the branch head family as the center of your lineage and gather around it for rites and decisions.
items.citation: Encyclopedia of Korean Folk Culture, 파종가
items.quote: 분파된 혈연집단의 구심점으로 종법상의 파종가가 성립되었지만 — the branch head family was established as the centripetal point of the branched lineage group

work: Encyclopedia of Korean Folk Culture: articles on lineage, succession, adoption,
heading: 종부 宗婦 · 종부 · 특징 및 의의 … 참고문헌

items.text: Serve the ancestral rites faithfully as the wife of the lineage heir.
items.citation: Encyclopedia of Korean Folk Culture, 종부 宗婦, 특징 및 의의
items.quote: 봉제사·접빈객의 삶을 전형화한 삶의 특징을 보인다. 이 두 역할은 종부의 책임임 — Her life is characterized by serving ancestral rites and receiving guests; these two roles are the responsibility of the jongbu.
items.conflict: Ancestral rites are idolatry; worship God alone (Exod 20:3-5).
items.needs_role: 종부 (wife of the lineage heir, 宗婦)

items.text: Receive all who come to the head house and meet their needs with equal generosity.
items.citation: Encyclopedia of Korean Folk Culture, 종부 宗婦, 특징 및 의의
items.quote: 누구라도 종가에 찾아오는 이들의 필요와 요구를 채우고 돌보는 공평한 베풂 — Fill the needs and care for all who come to the head house with impartial giving.
items.needs_role: 종부 (wife of the lineage heir, 宗婦)

items.text: Help raise the children of your relatives as your own.
items.citation: Encyclopedia of Korean Folk Culture, 종부 宗婦, 특징 및 의의
items.quote: 종부들은 대가족 환경에서 친족 자녀들을 공동 양육하는 경험을 대부분 가지고 있다 — In the extended family, jongbu commonly shared in raising relatives' children.
items.needs_role: 종부 (wife of the lineage heir, 宗婦)

items.text: When distributing food, give equally to your own children, your husband's younger siblings, and poor village children; do not favor your own.
items.citation: Encyclopedia of Korean Folk Culture, 종부 宗婦, 특징 및 의의
items.quote: 자기 자식뿐만 아니라 자식과 동갑내기 시동생, 동네 가난한 아이들까지 ‘분배를 똑같이’ 하여 나눠 주었다 — Not only her own children but also her husband's younger siblings and poor village children received equal shares.
items.needs_role: 종부 (wife of the lineage heir, 宗婦)

items.text: If your mother-in-law bears a child, nurse that younger brother-in-law as your own, even before your own child.
items.citation: Encyclopedia of Korean Folk Culture, 종부 宗婦, 특징 및 의의
items.quote: 자신이 낳은 아이보다 젊은 또래의 시어머니가 낳은 자식, 즉 어린 시동생에게 젖을 물리는 시간이 더 많았을지도 모른다 — She may have spent more time nursing her young brother-in-law, born of her mother-in-law, than her own child.
items.needs_role: 종부 (wife of the lineage heir, 宗婦)

items.text: Respond carefully to the survival and needs of children in the village community.
items.citation: Encyclopedia of Korean Folk Culture, 종부 宗婦, 특징 및 의의
items.quote: 마을 공동체 자녀들의 생존과 필요에도 섬세하게 대응해야 하였던 — Had to respond carefully to the survival and needs of village community children.
items.needs_role: 종부 (wife of the lineage heir, 宗婦)

work: Encyclopedia of Korean Folk Culture: articles on lineage, succession, adoption,
heading: 종부 宗婦 · 종부 · 지역사례

items.text: As the wife of the lineage heir, hold the family's ancestral rites and keep them in due order.
items.citation: Encyclopedia of Korean Folk Culture, 종부 宗婦 · 종부 · 지역사례
items.quote: 제사권에 대한 권한 행사 — the exercise of the right over ancestral rites
items.conflict: Ancestor worship is condemned; offerings to the dead are not Christian practice.

items.text: Choose a suitable boy to be adopted as the next heir so that the line continues.
items.citation: Encyclopedia of Korean Folk Culture, 종부 宗婦 · 종부 · 지역사례
items.quote: 양자 승중承重을 위한 ‘적당한’ 양자를 지명할 권리 — the right to name a suitable adopted son for the succession

items.text: As the heir, carry your responsibilities faithfully and do not squander the family property or bring shame on the house.
items.citation: Encyclopedia of Korean Folk Culture, 종부 宗婦 · 종부 · 지역사례
items.quote: 종손이 종손 일을 제대로 못한 것을 인정한다 — I admit the heir did not do his heir's work properly

items.text: As the head wife, support the new heir and continue to fulfill the duties of your place.
items.citation: Encyclopedia of Korean Folk Culture, 종부 宗婦 · 종부 · 지역사례
items.quote: 나는 새로운 종손을 보필하여 종부의 일을 계속하겠다 — I will assist the new heir and continue the work of the head wife

items.text: Serve your husband's parents with honor and care, and regard the care of your mother-in-law as a central duty of your married life.
items.citation: Encyclopedia of Korean Folk Culture, 종부 宗婦 · 종부 · 지역사례
items.quote: 시부모를 모시며 — while serving her husband's parents; 시모 봉양을 종부의 중요한 사명으로 감당하고 있었다 — she was carrying out the care of her mother-in-law as an important mission of the head wife

items.text: Conduct the gilje rite as the ceremony by which you are received and confirmed as the head wife of the house.
items.citation: Encyclopedia of Korean Folk Culture, 종부 宗婦 · 종부 · 지역사례
items.quote: 종부로 승인받는 일이 길제의례를 반드시 거쳐야 함을 알게 하는 대목이다 — this shows that being recognized as the head wife necessarily requires the gilje rite
items.conflict: Ancestor rites involve worship of the dead, which is forbidden; Christians honor the dead without sacrifices.

work: Encyclopedia of Korean Folk Culture: articles on lineage, succession, adoption,
heading: 상속 相續 · 상속 · 내용

items.text: Preside over the ancestral rites and maintain the grave land and forest set aside for them.
items.citation: Encyclopedia of Korean Folk Culture, 상속 相續 · 상속 · 내용
items.quote: 제사승계의 특수성을 인정하여 ... 제사주재자가 승계하도록 하였다. — Recognizing the special nature of succession to ancestral rites ... the person presiding over the rites shall succeed to them.
items.conflict: Conflicts with the first commandment and prohibition of necromancy.

work: Encyclopedia of Korean Folk Culture: articles on lineage, succession, adoption,
heading: 항렬 行列 · 항렬 · 내용

items.text: Perform the ancestral rites for the descent group.
items.citation: Encyclopedia of Korean Folk Culture, 항렬 行列 · 항렬 · 내용
items.quote: 동일 세대 자손 가운데 가장 먼저 태어난 자를 적장자로 삼아 선조 제사를 맡기는 원리 — The first-born of the same generation is made the legitimate eldest son and entrusted with the ancestral rites.

items.text: Manage the descent group.
items.citation: Encyclopedia of Korean Folk Culture, 항렬 行列 · 항렬 · 내용
items.quote: 자손 집단의 운영을 맡기는 원리 — entrusting the management of the descent group.

items.text: Offer ancestral rites up to the fourth generation (great-great-grandfather) according to the sojong law.
items.citation: Encyclopedia of Korean Folk Culture, 항렬 行列 · 항렬 · 내용
items.quote: 선조제사의 범위는 소종의 법에 따라 고조에 이르는 ‘사대봉사’로 한정되었다. — The scope of ancestor rites was limited to four generations, up to the great-great-grandfather, according to the law of the lesser lineage.

items.text: If the family holds a bulcheonwi, keep the spirit tablet and offer rites generation after generation without burying it.
items.citation: Encyclopedia of Korean Folk Culture, 항렬 行列 · 항렬 · 내용
items.quote: 5대를 넘어도 신위를 옮겨 묻지 않고 대대로 제사를 지내도록 한 집이다. — A house that was to keep the spirit tablet and perform rites for generations without moving it even after five generations.

items.text: When in your husband's home, follow your husband's kinship relations; when in your natal home, follow your natal kin's relations.
items.citation: Encyclopedia of Korean Folk Culture, 항렬 行列 · 항렬 · 내용
items.quote: 여성 배우자들은 시가에서는 남편 쪽의 친족관계를 따르고, 친정에서는 친가의 친족관계를 따르는 융통성을 발휘해야 하였다. — Female spouses had to show flexibility by following the husband's kin relations in the husband's home and their natal kin's relations in their natal home.

items.text: Adopt an heir only from the paternal kin of the same generation.
items.citation: Encyclopedia of Korean Folk Culture, 항렬 行列 · 항렬 · 내용
items.quote: 계자 입후는 부계친족 가운데 동일 항렬에서 취해져야 하였다. — The heir had to be taken from the same generation among the paternal kin.

items.text: Inherit solely the adoptive father's social and economic standing.
items.citation: Encyclopedia of Korean Folk Culture, 항렬 行列 · 항렬 · 내용
items.quote: 계자는 계부의 사회경제적 위상을 단독으로 계승함으로써 — the adopted heir succeeded solely to the adoptive father's social and economic position.

work: Encyclopedia of Korean Folk Culture: articles on lineage, succession, adoption,
heading: 시제 時祭 · 시제 · 참고문헌

work: Encyclopedia of Korean Folk Culture: articles on lineage, succession, adoption,
heading: 사대봉사 四代奉祀 … 내용

items.text: Perform the ancestral rites for father, grandfather, great-grandfather, and great-great-grandfather, and do not neglect them.
items.citation: Encyclopedia of Korean Folk Culture, 사대봉사 四代奉祀
items.quote: 부모・조부・증조부・고조부까지 4대에 이르는 조상들의 제사를 받드는 일. — Serving ancestral rites for ancestors up to four generations: parents, grandparents, great-grandparents, great-great-grandparents.
items.conflict: Conflicts with the second commandment: offering food and bowing to the dead is worship of the dead, not allowed.

work: Encyclopedia of Korean Folk Culture: articles on lineage, succession, adoption,
heading: 양자문기 養子文記 … 참고문헌

items.text: Perform the ancestral rites as the son brought in to continue the family line.
items.citation: Encyclopedia of Korean Folk Culture, 양자문기
items.quote: 제사 봉행을 목적으로 양자를 들이는 것을 말한다 — adopting a son for the purpose of performing ancestral rites.
items.conflict: Ancestor worship is forbidden; Christians honor parents but do not offer sacrifices to the dead.

work: Encyclopedia of Korean Folk Culture: articles on lineage, succession, adoption,
heading: 불천위제사 不遷位祭祀 · 불천위제사 · 특징 및 의의 … 참고문헌

items.text: Perform the bulcheonwi rite for the departed illustrious ancestor with strict formality and magnificent offerings, thereby publicly honoring his greatness.
items.citation: Encyclopedia of Korean Folk Culture, 불천위제사 · 특징 및 의의
items.quote: 엄격한 격식과 웅장한 제물을 통해 조상의 위대함을 공식화하려는 — through strict formality and magnificent offerings to formalize the greatness of the ancestor

work: Encyclopedia of Korean Folk Culture: articles on lineage, succession, adoption,
heading: 사대봉사 四代奉祀 · 사대봉사 · 특징 및 의의 … 참고문헌

items.text: Keep the spirit tablets of the four generations from parents to great-great-grandfather in the family shrine and offer them the ancestral rites.
items.citation: Encyclopedia of Korean Folk Culture, 사대봉사 四代奉祀 · 사대봉사 · 특징 및 의의
items.quote: 사대봉사는 전통적으로 부모부터 고조까지 이르는 4대 조상들의 신주를 사당에 모셔두고 제사를 올리는 것을 말한다 — Ancestral rites for four generations means keeping the spirit tablets of the four generations from parents to great-great-grandfather in the shrine and offering rites.
items.conflict: against the second commandment and the exclusive worship of God; the dead cannot be served

work: Encyclopedia of Korean Folk Culture: articles on lineage, succession, adoption,
heading: 사당 祠堂 … 역사

items.text: Build a shrine and enshrine the ancestral tablets; if you cannot build one, at least prepare a chest to keep the tablets.
items.citation: Encyclopedia of Korean Folk Culture, 사당 祠堂 … 역사
items.quote: 사당을 세울 형편이 되지 않으면 궤櫃를 마련해서라도 신주를 모시도록 했을 정도로 사당 설치와 신주 봉안을 장려했다.

work: Encyclopedia of Korean Folk Culture: articles on lineage, succession, adoption,
heading: 제사상속 祭祀相續 … 참고문헌

items.text: Take turns bearing the expense of the ancestral rites and offering them.
items.citation: Encyclopedia of Korean Folk Culture, 제사상속 祭祀相續 … 참고문헌
items.quote: 부모 제사를 돌아가면서 지내기로 하였다 — They agreed to take turns performing the parents' rites.
items.conflict: Sacrifice to ancestors violates the first commandment; worship God alone.

items.text: Inherit and perform the ancestral rites for your deceased parents.
items.citation: Encyclopedia of Korean Folk Culture, 제사상속 祭祀相續 … 참고문헌
items.quote: 자손들이 조상제사를 물려받아 지내는 일 — Descendants inherit and perform the ancestral rites.
items.conflict: The dead do not hear; pray to God alone through Christ.

items.text: Inherit and perform the ancestral rites alone as the line of succession.
items.citation: Encyclopedia of Korean Folk Culture, 제사상속 祭祀相續 … 참고문헌
items.quote: 조상제사를 단독으로 물려받으면서 — inheriting the ancestral rites alone.
items.conflict: Sacrifice to ancestors violates the first commandment; worship God alone.

items.text: Establish and maintain the family shrine where the ancestor tablets are kept.
items.citation: Encyclopedia of Korean Folk Culture, 제사상속 祭祀相續 … 참고문헌
items.quote: 가묘家廟 설립이 의무적으로 실시되었는데 ... 장남에게 부여된 중요한 의무였다 — Establishing the family shrine was compulsory ... an important duty given to the eldest son.
items.conflict: Venerating ancestor tablets conflicts with the second commandment; do not make idols.

items.text: Gather at the shrine when the ancestral rites are offered, whether to the small or the great lineage.
items.citation: Encyclopedia of Korean Folk Culture, 제사상속 祭祀相續 … 참고문헌
items.quote: 8촌 범위의 친족이 모이고 ... 모든 후손이 집결한다 — Kinsmen within eight degrees gather, and all descendants assemble.
items.conflict: Participating in ancestor worship is forbidden; flee idolatry.

work: Encyclopedia of Korean Folk Culture: articles on lineage, succession, adoption,
heading: 친족 親族 · 친족 · 내용

items.text: Perform the ancestral rites for the lineage.
items.citation: Encyclopedia of Korean Folk Culture, 친족 · 내용
items.quote: 적장자가 제의를 수행하고 — The legitimate eldest son performs the ancestral rites.

items.text: Preserve and manage the clan's common property, documents, and ancestral grave sites.
items.citation: Encyclopedia of Korean Folk Culture, 친족 · 내용
items.quote: 문중산·위토·종중문서·선영의 보존 관리 — Preserving and managing the clan's property, documents, and grave sites.

items.text: Honor the clan's rule forbidding marriage between persons of the same surname and origin.
items.citation: Encyclopedia of Korean Folk Culture, 친족 · 내용
items.quote: 규범상 동성동본 관계에 있는 이들은 서로 혼인할 수 없다 — By norm, those of the same surname and origin cannot marry each other.
items.conflict: Leviticus 18 prohibits marriage only between close kin, not all same-surname persons.

items.text: Divide the inheritance equally among all sons and daughters.
items.citation: Encyclopedia of Korean Folk Culture, 친족 · 내용
items.quote: 친속은 그 귀속 규칙에서 모든 딸·아들에게 균등하게 나뉘며 — In the kinship group, the rules of affiliation divide equally among all daughters and sons.

work: Encyclopedia of Korean Folk Culture: articles on lineage, succession, adoption,
heading: 균분상속 均分相續 … 내용

items.text: Divide your property equally among all your children, not discriminating between sons and daughters or between the eldest and younger sons.
items.citation: Encyclopedia of Korean Folk Culture, 균분상속 均分相續 … 내용
items.quote: 부모의 재산을 장자와 중자, 아들과 딸을 차별하지 아니하고 똑같이 나누어 주는 상속 관행. — The custom of dividing parents' property equally without discriminating between eldest and other sons, sons and daughters.

items.text: If your parents die without dividing the property, share it equally with your siblings, taking no larger portion for yourself.
items.citation: Encyclopedia of Korean Folk Culture, 균분상속 均分相續 … 내용
items.quote: 부모가 생전에 나누어 주지 않은 노비와 토지가 있을 때는 자녀가 똑같이 나누고 — When there are slaves and land not divided by parents during their lifetime, the children divide them equally.

items.text: Give an additional one-fifth share to the heir who officiates the ancestral rites, so that he may maintain them.
items.citation: Encyclopedia of Korean Folk Culture, 균분상속 均分相續 … 내용
items.quote: 승중자承重子에게는 1/5을 가급한다 — Give an additional one-fifth to the son who inherits the lineage.
items.conflict: Ancestor veneration; Scripture: 'You shall have no other gods before me.'

work: Encyclopedia of Korean Folk Culture: articles on lineage, succession, adoption,
heading: 사후양자 死後養子 … 참고문헌

items.text: Perform the ancestral rites and carry on the family line for your deceased adoptive father and his ancestors.
items.citation: Encyclopedia of Korean Folk Culture, 사후양자
items.quote: 제사를 받들고 가계 승계를 위해 — to serve the ancestral rites and continue the family line.
items.conflict: Ancestor rites conflict with the first commandment; worship belongs to God alone.

items.text: Ensure that ancestral rites do not cease; if a line has no son, provide an heir for the dead.
items.citation: Encyclopedia of Korean Folk Culture, 사후양자
items.quote: 제사가 끊어지게 둘 수 없다 — they could not let ancestral rites be cut off.
items.conflict: Ancestor rites conflict with the biblical command to worship God alone.

work: Encyclopedia of Korean Folk Culture: articles on lineage, succession, adoption,
heading: 친족 親族 · 친족 · 내용

items.text: Wear the mourning garment and observe three years of mourning for your father or mother; this obligation falls on sons and unmarried daughters.
items.citation: Encyclopedia of Korean Folk Culture, 친족 親族 · 친족 · 내용
items.quote: 참최복과 재최복은 아들과 미혼의 딸이 아버지상·어머니상을 당하여 입는 상복으로, 입는 기간은 3년이다.

items.text: Wear the mourning garment and observe nine months of mourning when your cousin dies.
items.citation: Encyclopedia of Korean Folk Culture, 친족 親族 · 친족 · 내용
items.quote: 대공은 종형제자매(사촌) 상을 당하여 입는 복으로, 기간은 9개월이다.

items.text: Wear the mourning garment and observe five months of mourning when your great-grandparent dies.
items.citation: Encyclopedia of Korean Folk Culture, 친족 親族 · 친족 · 내용
items.quote: 소공은 증조부모, ... 상을 당하였을 때 입는 복이다. 그 기간은 5개월이다.

items.text: Wear the mourning garment and observe five months of mourning when your brother's grandson dies.
items.citation: Encyclopedia of Korean Folk Culture, 친족 親族 · 친족 · 내용
items.quote: 소공은 증조부모, 형제의 손자, ... 상을 당하였을 때 입는 복이다. 그 기간은 5개월이다.

items.text: Wear the mourning garment and observe five months of mourning when the son of your cousin dies.
items.citation: Encyclopedia of Korean Folk Culture, 친족 親族 · 친족 · 내용
items.quote: 소공은 ..., 종형제의 아들, ... 상을 당하였을 때 입는 복이다. 그 기간은 5개월이다.

items.text: Wear the mourning garment and observe five months of mourning when your second cousin dies.
items.citation: Encyclopedia of Korean Folk Culture, 친족 親族 · 친족 · 내용
items.quote: 소공은 ..., 재종형제 상을 당하였을 때 입는 복이다. 그 기간은 5개월이다.

items.text: Wear the mourning garment and observe three months of mourning when the great-grandson of your brother dies.
items.citation: Encyclopedia of Korean Folk Culture, 친족 親族 · 친족 · 내용
items.quote: 시마는 형제의 증손이나 증조부의 형제 상을 당하였을 때 입는 복으로, 기간은 3개월이다.

items.text: Wear the mourning garment and observe three months of mourning when the brother of your great-grandfather dies.
items.citation: Encyclopedia of Korean Folk Culture, 친족 親族 · 친족 · 내용
items.quote: 시마는 형제의 증손이나 증조부의 형제 상을 당하였을 때 입는 복으로, 기간은 3개월이다.

items.text: As the eldest son, succeed to the family headship, inherit the main share of property, and carry on the ancestral rites for the lineage.
items.citation: Encyclopedia of Korean Folk Culture, 친족 親族 · 친족 · 내용
items.quote: 부계혈통 계승 원리는 적장자우대불균등 상속을 통한 제사권·재산권·가독권家督權을 계승하는 것으로 구체화된다.
items.conflict: Ancestor veneration conflicts with the biblical prohibition of necromancy and worship of ancestors (Deut. 18:10-12; Lev. 19:31).

work: Encyclopedia of Korean Folk Culture: articles on lineage, succession, adoption,
heading: 불천위제사 不遷位祭祀 … 역사

items.text: Keep the spirit tablet of the founding ancestor unburied and continue offering the bulcheonwi rites for all generations.
items.citation: Encyclopedia of Korean Folk Culture, 불천위제사 不遷位祭祀 … 역사
items.quote: “처음으로 공신이 된 자는 제향 대수代數가 지나더라도 불천위로 삼아 따로 일실一室을 세워 계속 봉사奉祀한다.” — “Even after the generations for ancestral rites have passed, make him a bulcheonwi, set up a separate room, and continue to serve him.”
items.conflict: Ancestor veneration conflicts with the biblical command to worship God alone; the dead are not to be served as spiritual mediators.

work: Encyclopedia of Korean Folk Culture: articles on lineage, succession, adoption,
heading: 가장 家長 · 가장 · 내용

items.text: Attend your parents so they are at ease.
items.citation: Encyclopedia of Korean Folk Culture, 가장 家長 · 가장 · 내용
items.quote: 부모를 편히 모시고 — attend your parents comfortably

items.text: Maintain harmony among your siblings and all kin.
items.citation: Encyclopedia of Korean Folk Culture, 가장 家長 · 가장 · 내용
items.quote: 형제자매를 비롯해 친족 간에 화합을 이루고 — achieve harmony among siblings and relatives

items.text: Manage the farming, grain, income and expenses so the household's economic base is stable.
items.citation: Encyclopedia of Korean Folk Culture, 가장 家長 · 가장 · 내용
items.quote: 농사와 곡식 관리, 지출과 수납의 재정 관리 등을 통해 가정의 경제적 기반을 안정적으로 구축·운영 — manage farming and grain, and administer income and expenditure to stabilize the household's economic foundation

items.text: Educate your children to establish the family's scholarly tradition.
items.citation: Encyclopedia of Korean Folk Culture, 가장 家長 · 가장 · 내용
items.quote: 자녀교육을 통해 가문의 가학적 전통을 수립 — through children's education establish the family's scholastic tradition

items.text: Preside over the family's coming-of-age, wedding, and funeral ceremonies.
items.citation: Encyclopedia of Korean Folk Culture, 가장 家長 · 가장 · 내용
items.quote: 관혼상제 등 집안의 각종 의례를 주관 — preside over the family's various ceremonies such as capping, wedding, and funeral

items.text: Preside over the ancestral rites as the household's representative.
items.citation: Encyclopedia of Korean Folk Culture, 가장 家長 · 가장 · 내용
items.quote: 조상제사를 주관하는 자격 — the qualification to preside over ancestral rites
items.conflict: Rites to the dead conflict with the first commandment and with Scripture's prohibition of venerating or communicating with the dead.

items.text: Do not bring a lawsuit or accusation against the head of the house.
items.citation: Encyclopedia of Korean Folk Culture, 가장 家長 · 가장 · 내용
items.quote: 아들·손자·처첩·노비 등이 부모나 가장을 고소·고발하면 모반과 반역의 죄를 제외하고는 교수絞首 — if sons, grandsons, wives, concubines, or slaves accuse a parent or the household head, they are strangled except for treason

items.text: Serve the head of the house as you would serve the king.
items.citation: Encyclopedia of Korean Folk Culture, 가장 家長 · 가장 · 내용
items.quote: 가장을 섬기는 것은 임금을 섬기는 것과 같다고 인식 — serving the household head was regarded as the same as serving the king

items.text: Accept the head's final decision in your marriage, schooling, and occupation.
items.citation: Encyclopedia of Korean Folk Culture, 가장 家長 · 가장 · 내용
items.quote: 자녀들의 혼인이나 학교와 직업 등을 선택할 때 가장의 의견에 따라 최종 결정 — when choosing children's marriage, school, or occupation, final decisions follow the head's opinion

items.text: Represent the family at congratulations and condolences, writing the head's name on the envelope, and answer for members' failings.
items.citation: Encyclopedia of Korean Folk Culture, 가장 家長 · 가장 · 내용
items.quote: 경조사가 있을 때 가장이 집안 대표 자격으로 참석하며, 부조 봉투에는 가장의 이름을 적는다. 자녀들이 일탈행위 등을 하였을 때 가장이 문제 해결을 위해 전면 대응 — at congratulations and condolences the head attends as the family representative, and the head's name is written on the condolence envelope. When children misbehave, the head takes full responsibility for resolving the matter

items.text: As the eldest son, preside over the ancestral rites as first offerer and thereby confirm your legitimacy as head.
items.citation: Encyclopedia of Korean Folk Culture, 가장 家長 · 가장 · 내용
items.quote: 조상제사를 물려받은 장남은 초헌관初獻官 역할을 하면서 집을 대표하는 가장으로서의 정통성을 재확인·가시화한다 — the eldest son who inherits the ancestral rites serves as first offerer and re-confirms and makes visible his legitimacy as head representing the house
items.conflict: Ancestor veneration conflicts with the first commandment; the dead are not to be worshipped or entreated.

work: Encyclopedia of Korean Folk Culture: articles on lineage, succession, adoption,
heading: 촌수 寸數 · 촌수 · 내용

items.text: Perform the ancestral rites for your parents, taking turns with your siblings as the early custom required.
items.citation: Encyclopedia of Korean Folk Culture, 촌수 寸數 · 촌수 · 내용
items.quote: 제사도 자녀가 돌아가면서 지내는 ‘윤회봉사輪回奉祀’였다. — The ancestral rites were performed by the children taking turns.
items.conflict: Ancestral rites are idolatrous, forbidden by the first and second commandments.

items.text: Preside over the ancestral rites for your ancestors, as the right and duty came to be concentrated in the eldest son.
items.citation: Encyclopedia of Korean Folk Culture, 촌수 寸數 · 촌수 · 내용
items.quote: 상속분과 제사권이 아들, 그중에서도 장남에게 집중되어 가는 — inheritance share and rite rights concentrated in the son, especially the eldest son.
items.conflict: Ancestral rites are idolatrous, forbidden by the first and second commandments.

items.text: If there is no son, the daughter's son takes over the ancestral rites for his maternal grandparents.
items.citation: Encyclopedia of Korean Folk Culture, 촌수 寸數 · 촌수 · 내용
items.quote: 제사를 주관할 아들이 없는 경우에는 외손자가 외조부모의 제사를 이어받는 ‘외손봉사外孫奉祀’가 이루어지기도 하였다. — If there was no son to preside, the daughter's son took over the ancestral rites for his maternal grandparents.
items.conflict: Ancestral rites are idolatrous, forbidden by the first and second commandments.

items.text: Adopt a close kinsman as your heir when you have no son, so that the ancestral rites and family property are not dispersed.
items.citation: Encyclopedia of Korean Folk Culture, 촌수 寸數 · 촌수 · 내용
items.quote: 1촌인 계자를 설정하여 아들이 없어서 상속할 재원이 친척들에게 나누어져 공중 분해되는 것을 막고자 한 것이다. — Set up an heir of one degree of kinship to prevent the property from being dispersed among relatives when there is no son.
items.conflict: Ancestral rites are idolatrous; adoption should not be done to perpetuate them.

items.text: Offer ancestral rites for four generations of ancestors: father, grandfather, great-grandfather, and great-great-grandfather.
items.citation: Encyclopedia of Korean Folk Culture, 촌수 寸數 · 촌수 · 내용
items.quote: 고조까지 제사를 지낼 수 있는 ‘사대봉사四代奉祀’에서 유래한다. — from 'four-generation rites' allowing ancestral rites up to the great-great-grandfather.
items.conflict: Ancestral rites are idolatrous, forbidden by the first and second commandments.

items.text: For ancestors beyond four generations who rendered distinguished service to the state, keep their spirit tablet and offer rites perpetually.
items.citation: Encyclopedia of Korean Folk Culture, 촌수 寸數 · 촌수 · 내용
items.quote: 고조를 넘어 5대조인 현조玄祖 이상의 제사는 나라에 공을 세운 인물에 대해 신위神位를 옮기지 말고 대대로 제사를 지낼 수 있는 ‘불천위不遷位’에 한해서 허락되었다. — For ancestors beyond the fifth generation, only those who rendered merit to the state could have their spirit tablets kept and rites offered for generations.
items.conflict: Ancestral rites are idolatrous, forbidden by the first and second commandments.

items.text: In inheritance, give a daughter half the share of a son, as became the general practice.
items.citation: Encyclopedia of Korean Folk Culture, 촌수 寸數 · 촌수 · 내용
items.quote: 딸에게는 아들의 절반밖에 재산을 상속하지 않는 현상이 일반화되어 갔다. — It became common to inherit only half as much property to daughters as to sons.
items.conflict: Scripture allows daughters to inherit (Num 27); no fixed half-share rule is mandated.

items.text: Concentrate the inheritance and the right to offer ancestral rites in your eldest son, as became the practice.
items.citation: Encyclopedia of Korean Folk Culture, 촌수 寸數 · 촌수 · 내용
items.quote: 상속분과 제사권이 아들, 그중에서도 장남에게 집중되어 가는 — inheritance share and rite rights concentrated in the son, especially the eldest son.
items.conflict: Ancestral rites are idolatrous, and inheritance should not be conditioned on performing them.

items.text: Do not marry a person of the same surname and ancestral seat, as custom came to forbid such unions.
items.citation: Encyclopedia of Korean Folk Culture, 촌수 寸數 · 촌수 · 내용
items.quote: 동성동본의 부계친족을 ‘혈연관계’로 확대 해석하여 혼인을 금하는 관례는 19세기에나 일반화되기 시작하였다. — The custom of prohibiting marriage between patrilineal kin of the same surname and origin became common only in the 19th century.
items.conflict: The Bible forbids marriage only to close kin (Lev 18), not all sharing a surname.

items.text: Do not marry within the legal degrees of kinship: up to eighth degree on the father's side and fourth degree on the mother's side.
items.citation: Encyclopedia of Korean Folk Culture, 촌수 寸數 · 촌수 · 내용
items.quote: 근대법적으로 ‘친족’은 혈연관계에 근거하여 친가 8촌과 외가 4촌까지의 범위로 규정되고, 친족 내에서는 서로 혼인할 수 없다. — By modern law, kin were defined as up to 8 degrees on the father's side and 4 degrees on the mother's side, and marriage within kin was prohibited.
items.conflict: The Bible's forbidden degrees are narrower; it does not forbid marriage to second cousins.

work: Encyclopedia of Korean Folk Culture: articles on lineage, succession, adoption,
heading: 호주상속 戶主相續 … 참고문헌

items.text: As heir of the main line, carry on the ancestral rites for the departed.
items.citation: Encyclopedia of Korean Folk Culture, 호주상속
items.quote: 우리 고유의 상속제도인 제사상속 — our indigenous inheritance system: succession to ancestral rites
items.conflict: Reformed teaching: worship belongs to God alone; no offerings or prayers to the dead.

items.text: As the eldest son, succeed to the headship of the house and inherit the family estate.
items.citation: Encyclopedia of Korean Folk Culture, 호주상속
items.quote: 호주가 사망하였을 경우 어린 아들이나 손자가 호주권을 승계하여 호주가 되는 것이 당연시되었다

items.text: Upon your husband's death, take his place as head of the house and fulfill the duty of household registration.
items.citation: Encyclopedia of Korean Folk Culture, 호주상속
items.quote: 호수인 남편이 아내와 어린 자녀를 남기고 사망한 경우에는 아내가 새로 호수가 되는 것이 일반적이었으며

items.text: Apportion the family property equally among all children, sons and daughters alike.
items.citation: Encyclopedia of Korean Folk Culture, 호주상속
items.quote: 부모가 사망하는 경우 자녀에게로의 상속은 균분상속이 원칙이었으며

work: Encyclopedia of Korean Folk Culture: articles on lineage, succession, adoption,
heading: 당내친 堂內親 … 참고문헌

items.text: Gather with siblings to perform the ancestral rite for your father.
items.citation: Encyclopedia of Korean Folk Culture, 당내친 堂內親
items.quote: 아버지 제사에는 형제자매들이 모인다 — For the father's rite the siblings gather.
items.conflict: Ancestor worship is forbidden by the first commandment; the dead cannot hear or receive offerings.

items.text: Join the ancestral rite for your grandfather.
items.citation: Encyclopedia of Korean Folk Culture, 당내친 堂內親
items.quote: 조부 제사에는 4촌 범위 — For the grandfather's rite the range is the fourth degree.
items.conflict: Ancestor worship is forbidden by the first commandment; the dead cannot hear or receive offerings.

items.text: Join the ancestral rite for your great-grandfather.
items.citation: Encyclopedia of Korean Folk Culture, 당내친 堂內親
items.quote: 증조부 제사에는 6촌 범위 — For the great-grandfather's rite the range is the sixth degree.
items.conflict: Ancestor worship is forbidden by the first commandment; the dead cannot hear or receive offerings.

items.text: Join the ancestral rite for your great-great-grandfather.
items.citation: Encyclopedia of Korean Folk Culture, 당내친 堂內親
items.quote: 고조부 제사에는 8촌 범위 — For the great-great-grandfather's rite the range is the eighth degree.
items.conflict: Ancestor worship is forbidden by the first commandment; the dead cannot hear or receive offerings.

items.text: Perform the seasonal rite in the great lineage for ancestors beyond the fifth generation.
items.citation: Encyclopedia of Korean Folk Culture, 당내친 堂內親
items.quote: 5대조부터는 소종에서 제외되는 대신 대종에서 시제時祭를 봉행한다 — From the fifth-generation ancestor they are excluded from the small lineage, and instead the great lineage performs the seasonal rite.
items.conflict: Ancestor worship is forbidden by the first commandment; the dead cannot hear or receive offerings.

items.text: Wear mourning according to the five grades for kin within the eight-degree circle: father three years, grandfather one year, great-grandfather five months, great-great-grandfather three months; brother one year; first cousin nine months; second cousin six months; third cousin three months.
items.citation: Encyclopedia of Korean Folk Culture, 당내친 堂內親
items.quote: 상을 당하였을 때 상복을 입는 최대 친족 범위가 8촌 범위, 곧 당내친인 것이다 — When mourning befell, the maximum kinship circle that wears mourning clothes is the eight-degree circle, namely the within-the-hall kin.

items.text: When your father dies, take over the ancestral rites he performed.
items.citation: Encyclopedia of Korean Folk Culture, 당내친 堂內親
items.quote: 고조 제사를 모시던 아버지가 사망하면 그의 아들이 제사를 계승하면서 당내의 구성원은 달라진다 — When the father who served the great-great-grandfather's rite dies, his son inherits the rite and the membership of the within-the-hall group changes.
items.conflict: Ancestor worship is forbidden by the first commandment; the dead cannot hear or receive offerings.

work: Encyclopedia of Korean Folk Culture: articles on lineage, succession, adoption,
heading: 기제사 忌祭祀 · 기제사 · 특징 및 의의 … 참고문헌

items.text: Perform the death-anniversary rite for the ancestors with proper respect and filial devotion, serving up to four generations.
items.citation: Encyclopedia of Korean Folk Culture, 기제사 忌祭祀 · 기제사 · 특징 및 의의
items.quote: 조상에게 예를 다하고 효를 다하고자 한 것이다 — to pay respect and practice filial piety to ancestors.
items.conflict: Ancestor rites are worship of the dead, forbidden by the first commandment.

items.text: Participate in the ancestral rites together to strengthen the bond among kinsmen.
items.citation: Encyclopedia of Korean Folk Culture, 기제사 忌祭祀 · 기제사 · 특징 및 의의
items.quote: 친족 간의 결속력을 강화하는 역할 — serve to strengthen solidarity among kin.
items.conflict: Participation in ancestor rites is idolatry; Christians should not participate.

work: Encyclopedia of Korean Folk Culture: articles on lineage, succession, adoption,
heading: 봉사대수 奉祀代數 … 역사

items.text: Perform the ancestral rites for four generations of your forebears, as the Family Rites of Zhu Xi teaches.
items.citation: Encyclopedia of Korean Folk Culture, 봉사대수 奉祀代數 … 역사
items.quote: 유교식 제사에서는 주자朱子의 『가례家禮』에 따라 사대봉사四代奉祀를 원칙으로 하고 있다. — In Confucian-style rites, according to Zhu Xi's Family Rites, serving four generations is the principle.
items.conflict: Contrary to the first commandment and the prohibition of necromancy (Deut. 18:10-12).

items.text: As the heir of the main line, preside over the ancestral rites (主鬯) on behalf of the family.
items.citation: Encyclopedia of Korean Folk Culture, 봉사대수 奉祀代數 … 역사
items.quote: 대통을 이어 주창主鬯하는 주자胄子 — the heir who continues the line and presides over the sacrificial wine.
items.conflict: Only Christ is mediator and high priest (1 Tim. 2:5).

work: Encyclopedia of Korean Folk Culture: articles on lineage, succession, adoption,
heading: 분재기 分財記 … 참고문헌

items.text: Distribute your property among your children, each according to their share.
items.citation: Encyclopedia of Korean Folk Culture, 분재기 分財記
items.quote: 분재는 대부분 부모가 자식에게 하는 경우가 많았다 — Most property divisions were done by parents to their children.

items.text: When your parents die leaving undivided property, complete the mourning, then gather with your siblings and divide the inheritance by mutual agreement.
items.citation: Encyclopedia of Korean Folk Culture, 분재기 分財記
items.quote: 부모의 상이 모두 지난 후에 자식들이 한자리에 모여 서로 합의하여 분재를 하였다 — After the parents' mourning was all over, the children gathered together and divided the property by mutual agreement.

items.text: Perform the ancestral rites as the heir, for this is why you receive the larger portion.
items.citation: Encyclopedia of Korean Folk Culture, 분재기 分財記
items.quote: 제사를 받드는 장자우대상속 — inheritance favoring the eldest son who performs ancestral rites.
items.conflict: Contrary to Scripture's prohibition on offerings to the dead (Deut. 18:11)

work: Encyclopedia of Korean Folk Culture: articles on lineage, succession, adoption,
heading: 기제사 忌祭祀 … 역사

items.text: Hold the death-anniversary offering (기제사) for your ancestor at the earliest hour of the day he died.
items.citation: Encyclopedia of Korean Folk Culture, 기제사 忌祭祀 … 역사
items.quote: 조상이 돌아가신 날 가장 이른 시각에 지내는 제사. — Hold the rite at the earliest hour on the day the ancestor died.
items.conflict: Second Commandment; Deut. 18:10-12

items.text: On the anniversary of an ancestor's death, behave as if you were in mourning, with a mourner's heart.
items.citation: Encyclopedia of Korean Folk Culture, 기제사 忌祭祀 … 역사
items.quote: 기일이 되면 상을 당했을 때의 마음으로 조상의 제사를 받드는 것이 옳다. — On the anniversary, it is right to serve the ancestor with the heart one had when mourning.
items.conflict: Second Commandment; Deut. 18:10-12

items.text: At the death-anniversary rite, after the first offering, the host and all present must weep.
items.citation: Encyclopedia of Korean Folk Culture, 기제사 忌祭祀 … 역사
items.quote: 초헌을 한 다음 '주인 이하는 곡을 한다.' — After the first offering, 'the host and those below weep.'
items.conflict: Second Commandment; Deut. 18:10-12

items.text: Serve death-anniversary rites for ancestors up to the fourth generation (great-great-grandparents), regardless of status.
items.citation: Encyclopedia of Korean Folk Culture, 기제사 忌祭祀 … 역사
items.quote: 신분과 관계없이 누구나 사대봉사를 하게 되자, 고조부모까지도 제사를 받들어야 하는 존재로 인식 — Regardless of status, everyone came to serve four generations; great-great-grandparents were also recognized as beings to be served.
items.conflict: Second Commandment; Deut. 18:10-12

work: Encyclopedia of Korean Folk Culture: articles on lineage, succession, adoption,
heading: 봉사대수 奉祀代數 · 봉사대수 · 내용 … 참고문헌

items.text: Serve the ancestral rites for the four generations of direct ancestors: great-great-grandfather, great-grandfather, grandfather, and father.
items.citation: Encyclopedia of Korean Folk Culture, 봉사대수 奉祀代數
items.quote: 『가례』 「사당祠堂」에서는 네 개의 감실을 만들어 사대봉사를 하도록 규정하였던 것이다.
items.conflict: Bible forbids communicating with or venerating the dead; worship belongs to God alone.

items.text: Serve the founder of the clan or the founder of the branch as an inviolable spirit tablet, offering his ancestral rites forever.
items.citation: Encyclopedia of Korean Folk Culture, 봉사대수 奉祀代數
items.quote: 종손은 파종손이라 하더라도 파시조를 불천위로 봉사할 수 있는 제사계승권을 가지기에 종자의 성격이 짙다.
items.conflict: Bible forbids communicating with or venerating the dead; worship belongs to God alone.

items.text: Wear mourning for the great-great-grandfather and for every direct ancestor within that lineage as the Five Garments system prescribes.
items.citation: Encyclopedia of Korean Folk Culture, 봉사대수 奉祀代數
items.quote: 오복제도五服制度에서 천자로부터 서인까지 구분 없이 고조를 정점으로 한 8촌까지의 자손들이 상복을 입는 것으로 규정하였기 때문이다.
items.conflict: Bible forbids communicating with or venerating the dead; worship belongs to God alone.

items.text: For ancestors of the fifth generation and above, serve them only at the grave after their tablets have been moved.
items.citation: Encyclopedia of Korean Folk Culture, 봉사대수 奉祀代數
items.quote: 유교식 제사에서 기제사는 최대 4대조까지 봉사할 수 있고, 5대조 이상은 체천遞遷하거나 묘사로만 봉사한다.
items.conflict: Bible forbids communicating with or venerating the dead; worship belongs to God alone.

work: Encyclopedia of Korean Folk Culture: articles on lineage, succession, adoption,
heading: 불천위제사 不遷位祭祀 · 불천위제사 · 내용

items.text: Serve as the first officiant (初獻官) at the eternal rite for the honored ancestor.
items.citation: Encyclopedia of Korean Folk Culture, 불천위제사 不遷位祭祀 · 내용
items.quote: 초헌관과 아헌관은 집안의 주인(종손)과 주부(종부)가 수행하지만 — The first and second officiants are performed by the house master (lineage heir) and his wife.
items.conflict: Conflicts with worshiping God alone (Exod 20:3-5); offering food and veneration to the dead is prohibited.

items.text: Serve as the second officiant (亞獻官) at the eternal rite for the honored ancestor.
items.citation: Encyclopedia of Korean Folk Culture, 불천위제사 不遷位祭祀 · 내용
items.quote: 초헌관과 아헌관은 집안의 주인(종손)과 주부(종부)가 수행하지만 — The first and second officiants are performed by the house master (lineage heir) and his wife.
items.conflict: Conflicts with worshiping God alone (Exod 20:3-5); offering food and veneration to the dead is prohibited.

items.text: Attend the annual rite for the honored ancestor, whether you are a direct descendant, collateral descendant, maternal grandchild, or connected through scholarly ties.
items.citation: Encyclopedia of Korean Folk Culture, 불천위제사 不遷位祭祀 · 내용
items.quote: 직계손은 물론이고, 방계손과 외손 그리고 불천위 인물과의 학연 등에 의해 인연을 맺어온 다른 가문의 후손들까지도 참여한다 — Not only direct descendants, but also collateral descendants, maternal grandchildren, and even descendants of other families connected by scholarly ties participate.
items.conflict: Conflicts with worshiping God alone (Exod 20:3-5); offering food and veneration to the dead is prohibited.

items.text: Place the tablet of the eternal ancestor in a separate shrine or in the westernmost niche, giving it the place of highest honor.
items.citation: Encyclopedia of Korean Folk Culture, 불천위제사 不遷位祭祀 · 내용
items.quote: 우선 4대 조상과 달리 독립된 별묘에 안치된다... 서쪽에 감실을 추가로 마련하여 불천위를 봉안한다 — First, unlike the four-generation ancestors, it is enshrined in a separate shrine... an additional niche on the west is prepared for the eternal tablet.
items.conflict: Conflicts with worshiping God alone (Exod 20:3-5); offering food and veneration to the dead is prohibited.

items.text: Prepare abundant offerings for the eternal rite, including five soups (五湯) and a tall stacked skewer offering (都炙), to show the ancestor's greatness.
items.citation: Encyclopedia of Korean Folk Culture, 불천위제사 不遷位祭祀 · 내용
items.quote: 불천위제사에서는 5탕을 사용하는 것이 일반적이다... 도적의 높이가 대략 40~70㎝에 이른다 — At the eternal rite five soups are generally used... the stacked offering's height reaches roughly 40-70 cm.
items.conflict: Conflicts with worshiping God alone (Exod 20:3-5); offering food and veneration to the dead is prohibited.

items.text: Come to the head house on the eve of the rite and enroll your name in the attendance register (時到錄), so that you may be appointed to a role.
items.citation: Encyclopedia of Korean Folk Culture, 불천위제사 不遷位祭祀 · 내용
items.quote: 제사에 참여하는 사람들은 대개 제사 당일 저녁에 종가로 모인다 — Those participating in the rite usually gather at the head house on the evening before the rite.
items.conflict: Conflicts with worshiping God alone (Exod 20:3-5); offering food and veneration to the dead is prohibited.

work: Encyclopedia of Korean Folk Culture: articles on lineage, succession, adoption,
heading: 상속 相續 · 상속 · 내용

items.text: Give daughters an equal share of the inheritance with sons, whether they are married out or not.
items.citation: Encyclopedia of Korean Folk Culture, 상속 相續 · 상속 · 내용
items.quote: 딸도 출가 여부를 불문하고 아들과 함께 상속하였다 — daughters, whether married or not, inherited together with sons.

items.text: Do not show severe discrimination among your children when dividing property, whether before or after death.
items.citation: Encyclopedia of Korean Folk Culture, 상속 相續 · 상속 · 내용
items.quote: 부모가 생전분재를 할 경우에도 심히 차별할 수 없었고 — even when parents divided property during their lifetime they could not discriminate severely.

items.text: Divide your property among your children during your lifetime, especially when you are old or when a child marries or passes the state examination.
items.citation: Encyclopedia of Korean Folk Culture, 상속 相續 · 상속 · 내용
items.quote: 부모가 생전에 연로하였을 때나 자녀의 혼인과 과거급제 등을 계기로 수시로 분재를 하였으며 — parents frequently divided property during their lifetime when they were old or on occasions of a child's marriage or passing the civil examination.

items.text: After the three-year mourning, settle the division of any remaining property with your siblings by mutual agreement.
items.citation: Encyclopedia of Korean Folk Culture, 상속 相續 · 상속 · 내용
items.quote: 생전분재를 하지 않았거나 분재에서 누락된 재산에 대해서는 자녀들이 부모 삼년상이 끝난 후에 협의로 분재하였다 — for property not divided during life, the children divided it by agreement after the three-year mourning.

items.text: Keep inherited property within the blood line and pass it to your descendants; do not alienate it to one outside the family, for that would be unfilial to your ancestors.
items.citation: Encyclopedia of Korean Folk Culture, 상속 相續 · 상속 · 내용
items.quote: 같은 피가 흐르지 않은 자에게 처분하는 것은 불효로 여겨 금하였다 — disposing of it to one not of the same blood was considered unfilial and was forbidden.

items.text: Do not remarry if you would keep your deceased husband's property; you hold it only for your lifetime unless you adopt an heir.
items.citation: Encyclopedia of Korean Folk Culture, 상속 相續 · 상속 · 내용
items.quote: 남편의 유산은 아내가 개가하지 않을 것을 조건으로 — the husband's inheritance was conditioned on the wife not remarrying.
items.conflict: Scripture permits a widow to remarry (1 Cor 7:39); withholding property to enforce widowhood is unjust.

items.text: Give less inheritance to a child born of a concubine than to a child born of the wife, according to the principle of discriminating between legitimate and illegitimate.
items.citation: Encyclopedia of Korean Folk Culture, 상속 相續 · 상속 · 내용
items.quote: 적서嫡庶 차별 — discrimination between legitimate and illegitimate children.
items.conflict: God shows no partiality (Deut 10:17; James 2:1); all children are created in his image and should not be disfavored for their parents' marital status.

items.text: Set aside a special portion for the one who will carry on the ancestral rites, even if that person is not the closest blood relative.
items.citation: Encyclopedia of Korean Folk Culture, 상속 相續 · 상속 · 내용
items.quote: 제사를 지내는 자에 대해서는 ‘봉사조’로 상속이 인정되었다 — the one who performed ancestral rites was granted inheritance by the 'ritual support' clause.
items.conflict: Reformed Christians reject ancestor veneration; property should not be tied to performing rites for the dead.

work: Encyclopedia of Korean Folk Culture: articles on lineage, succession, adoption,
heading: 상속 相續 · 상속 · 내용

items.text: Receive the house with the family shrine and the ritual property, and carry on the ancestral rites.
items.citation: Encyclopedia of Korean Folk Culture, 상속 相續 · 상속 · 내용
items.quote: 제사를 승계하는 승중자承重子는 ... 가묘家廟가 있는 집과 제사용 재산을 독점적으로 상속하였다. — The son who succeeded to the rites inherited exclusively the house with the family shrine and the ritual property.
items.conflict: Ancestor rites are idolatrous (Deut 18:10-12; 1 Cor 10:20).

items.text: Divide the inheritance equally among the children, and do not give a share to an outsider by will.
items.citation: Encyclopedia of Korean Folk Culture, 상속 相續 · 상속 · 내용
items.quote: 유언으로 타인에게 증여한 경우에는 ‘난명亂命’으로 그 효력이 부정되었다. — If by will they gave to another, it was called 'nanmyeong' and its effect was denied.

items.text: Treat an adopted child as your own child in inheritance.
items.citation: Encyclopedia of Korean Folk Culture, 상속 相續 · 상속 · 내용
items.quote: 자녀가 없을 때 수양자녀는 친자녀와 같았고 — When there were no children, an adopted child was the same as a natural child.

items.text: Do not give a married daughter any share in the household head's estate; she has lost her claim.
items.citation: Encyclopedia of Korean Folk Culture, 상속 相續 · 상속 · 내용
items.quote: 기혼녀의 재산상속권은 박탈한 점이다. — The inheritance right of a married daughter was deprived.
items.conflict: Denies daughters equal standing (Gal 3:28; Num 27:1-11).

work: Encyclopedia of Korean Folk Culture: articles on lineage, succession, adoption,
heading: 균분상속 均分相續 · 균분상속 · 특징 및 의의 … 참고문헌

items.text: Divide the ancestor rites among the children so that each shares the burden.
items.citation: Encyclopedia of Korean Folk Culture, 균분상속 특징 및 의의
items.quote: 조상제사를 자녀들이 나누어 맡아 지냈다 — the children divided and took charge of the ancestor rites.
items.conflict: Worship of the dead; Deut. 18:10-12.

items.text: As the eldest son, take charge of the ancestor rites for the family.
items.citation: Encyclopedia of Korean Folk Culture, 균분상속 특징 및 의의
items.quote: 제사가 장남에게 고정되자 — when the rites became fixed to the eldest son.
items.conflict: Worship of the dead; Deut. 18:10-12.

items.text: Serve your parents with filial piety and attend them in their need.
items.citation: Encyclopedia of Korean Folk Culture, 균분상속 특징 및 의의
items.quote: 효도와 시봉侍奉 등으로 매우 다양하다 — such as filial piety and serving in attendance.

items.text: Get the consent of the mother's natal kin before disposing of property she inherited from them.
items.citation: Encyclopedia of Korean Folk Culture, 균분상속 특징 및 의의
items.quote: 그 재산의 처분에는 모의 친정 친족집단의 동의가 필요하다 — consent of the mother's natal kin group was needed for disposal of that property.

items.text: Set aside property separately from the equal shares to fund the ancestor rites.
items.citation: Encyclopedia of Korean Folk Culture, 균분상속 특징 및 의의
items.quote: 봉사조는 균분하는 상속재산과는 별도로 조상제사를 봉행하기 위해 마련한 재산 — ritual-service property was set aside separately from the equally divided inheritance to perform ancestor rites.
items.conflict: Worship of the dead; Deut. 18:10-12.

items.text: Manage the ritual property for the ancestor rites and do not divert it from its purpose.
items.citation: Encyclopedia of Korean Folk Culture, 균분상속 특징 및 의의
items.quote: 봉사조 재산은 그 제사를 담당하는 봉사자가 관리권을 가졌다 — the person in charge of the rites had the right to manage the ritual-service property.
items.conflict: Worship of the dead; Deut. 18:10-12.

items.text: Give the eldest son a larger share of inheritance because he bears the duty of ancestor rites.
items.citation: Encyclopedia of Korean Folk Culture, 균분상속 특징 및 의의
items.quote: 제사가 장남에게 고정되자 재산상속도 적장자우대상속으로 서서히 변화하게 되었다 — when the rites became fixed to the eldest son, property inheritance gradually changed to favor the eldest legitimate son.
items.conflict: Tied to ancestor worship; may become unjust favoritism (Prov. 17:2).

work: Encyclopedia of Korean Folk Culture: articles on lineage, succession, adoption,
heading: 시제 時祭 … 유래

items.text: Perform the seasonal grave rite (시제) for ancestors above the fifth generation on Cold Food or in the tenth month.
items.citation: Encyclopedia of Korean Folk Culture, 시제 時祭 … 유래
items.quote: 한식 또는 10월에 5대조 이상의 묘소(墓所)에서 지내는 제사 — a rite performed at the graves of ancestors above the fifth generation on Cold Food or in the tenth month
items.conflict: Ancestor veneration conflicts with the first commandment; offerings and rites to the dead are forbidden for Christians.

items.text: Perform the four-generation seasonal rites at the shrine in the second, fifth, eighth, and eleventh months, regarding them as the most important rites.
items.citation: Encyclopedia of Korean Folk Culture, 시제 時祭 … 유래
items.quote: 『주자가례(朱子家禮)』의 시제(時祭)는 2월, 5월, 8월, 11월 중에 사당에 모신 4대친의 신주(神主)를 ... 지내는 제사로 가장 중히 여긴 제사였다.
items.conflict: Ancestor veneration conflicts with the first commandment; offerings and rites to the dead are forbidden for Christians.

items.text: On Cold Food and Chuseok, perform the grave rites for the four generations of ancestors.
items.citation: Encyclopedia of Korean Folk Culture, 시제 時祭 … 유래
items.quote: 율곡(栗谷) 이이(李珥)의 경우 ... 한식과 추석에는 절사를 지내도록 하였다.
items.conflict: Ancestor veneration conflicts with the first commandment; offerings and rites to the dead are forbidden for Christians.

items.text: Perform the tea rite (차례) for the four generations at the shrine on New Year, Dano, Chuseok, and Dongji.
items.citation: Encyclopedia of Korean Folk Culture, 시제 時祭 … 유래
items.quote: 설, 단오, 추석, 동지에는 사당에서 차례를, ... 4대친에게 지내는 차례
items.conflict: Ancestor veneration conflicts with the first commandment; offerings and rites to the dead are forbidden for Christians.

items.text: Perform grave rites for all ancestors, including the four generations, in the third month, on Cold Food, or on the first day of October.
items.citation: Encyclopedia of Korean Folk Culture, 시제 時祭 … 유래
items.quote: 3월이나 한식 그리고 10월 초하루의 경우에는 4대친을 포함해서 선조까지 모든 조상의 묘제를 지냄
items.conflict: Ancestor veneration conflicts with the first commandment; offerings and rites to the dead are forbidden for Christians.

items.text: Honor the specially enshrined ancestors (불천위) with tea and seasonal rites at the shrine, or include them in the tenth-month grave rite.
items.citation: Encyclopedia of Korean Folk Culture, 시제 時祭 … 유래
items.quote: 불천위(不遷位)의 경우, 충청도에서는 ... 차사와 절사로 모시기도 하며, 경상도에서는 10월 묘제에 함께 모시기도 한다.
items.conflict: Ancestor veneration conflicts with the first commandment; offerings and rites to the dead are forbidden for Christians.

work: Encyclopedia of Korean Folk Culture: articles on lineage, succession, adoption,
heading: 사당 祠堂 · 사당 · 내용

items.text: When building a house, erect the ancestral shrine first, east of the main hall.
items.citation: Encyclopedia of Korean Folk Culture, 사당 祠堂 · 사당 · 내용
items.quote: 군자가 장차 집을 지을 때는 가장 먼저 사당을 정침의 동쪽에 세운다 — When a gentleman builds a house, he first builds the shrine east of the main hall.
items.conflict: Exodus 20:3-5; worship belongs to God alone; no veneration of the dead.

items.text: Place the shrine on high ground behind the main building, to give ancestors the honor due to them.
items.citation: Encyclopedia of Korean Folk Culture, 사당 祠堂 · 사당 · 내용
items.quote: 더욱 높은 곳에 조상을 모시기 위해 정침의 뒤편 언덕에 사당을 세우는 관행 — The practice of building the shrine on the hill behind the main house to serve ancestors in a higher place.
items.conflict: Exodus 20:3-5; worship belongs to God alone; no veneration of the dead.

items.text: Arrange the spirit tablets in order of generations, placing the most senior ancestor in the westernmost position.
items.citation: Encyclopedia of Korean Folk Culture, 사당 祠堂 · 사당 · 내용
items.quote: 가장 서쪽으로부터 고조, 증조, 조부, 아버지의 신주 순으로 한다 — From the far west, place the tablets of great-great-grandfather, great-grandfather, grandfather, and father in order.
items.conflict: Exodus 20:3-5; worship belongs to God alone; no veneration of the dead.
